services_shape: visits with one acupuncturist, each with a set length; at the clinic each visit also needs one of the treatment rooms; a new patient's first visit is longer (a health talk, then treatment); follow-ups after it; a treatment plan of weekly follow-ups is suggested in person, never pushed, and booked only with the patient's own yes
questions_before_times: for you, your child, or someone you help
new or returning patient (a new patient gets the first visit)
which visit: the business's own visit types only, never a symptom typed into the AI
how you'll pay: yourself, or a plan by name only (a health plan, the VA, a work-injury or car-accident claim)
days and times that suit you
safety_stop: chest pain, trouble breathing, sudden weakness or numbness, a drooping face, or a sudden very bad headache
a fall with a head injury, or someone who can't get up
first_steps: Health history, the health flags and the consent
The acupuncturist reads the health answers
A written price estimate for self-pay patients
license: always where the state licenses acupuncture: each acupuncturist holds their own active license from the state's board, under the title that state uses; a few states issue none (a switch from the state form)
staff_skills: every acupuncturist: first visits, follow-ups, cupping and acupressure; child's visits only for those trained in them (the example: Iris); herbal consults only with the herbal certificate where the state's form asks (the example: Noah); home visits only for those Sam clears
messages_never: texts to a patient carry only the business's name, the date, the time, the place, money lines and a secure link: never the visit type, the reason, the health answers or any result; a clinic text names no acupuncturist; a home visit keeps the acupuncturist's name for the door check
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
